summary.costScope: Concurrent endpoint wall values excluded. RHS/Jacobian evaluations retained. No runtime/memory dominance or publication cost pass asserted.

decisions.1: Reject generic scalar projection novelty and blanket trajectory-accuracy dominance; retain conditional invariant recovery as established baseline.
decisions.2: Reject finite RR/formation transfer as a new method: native solve already returns the same finite increment. CV enthalpy transfer also requires pressure change.
decisions.3: Reject generic transition-map interface novelty and sufficiency for later CFD density/pressure operators; existing independent codes already integrate invariant states.
decisions.4: Reject mechanism-only certification and generic predictive novelty. Observed crossing-weighted identity explains the direct jump but is not an independent prospective forecast.
decisions.5: Reject generic continuity repair novelty and physical-accuracy claim without original source data. Repair improves branch invariance but does not repair the CFD defect.
